Option A — Single block (preferred):
- Mon 9/13 14:00–15:30 PT — 60 min redline + 30 min onboarding prep

Option B — Two-sessions (legal then onboarding):
- Tue 9/14 10:00–11:00 PT — redline (Marissa + Ben)
- Tue 9/14 11:15–11:45 PT — onboarding prep (Laura + implementation lead)

Option C — Split over two days:
- Wed 9/15 09:00–10:00 PT — redline
- Thu 9/16 09:00–09:30 PT — onboarding prep

Notes / asks before the call:
- Please confirm which option works for Concordia and whether procurement will include final payment/contact person.
- If you have a preferred clause-by-clause list we should prioritize, drop it in the Drive link.
- We will circulate a short prep pack (staffing matrix + SSO checklist) ahead of the meeting.

Attachments to follow: onboarding-prep-checklist.xlsx (we'll share in the calendar invite).

If nothing fits, propose three 30-minute windows on your side and we will try to carve a compact slot.
